ask.label: 询问
ask.description: 敏感操作前等待用户确认。

readonly.label: 只读
readonly.description: 允许读取与分析，禁止写入和执行变更。

full.label: 完全访问
full.description: WARNING: grants broad auto-approval for routine workspace tools. High-risk host process / network / HTTP / browser / shell tool classes still require explicit confirmation (toolApprovalOverrides). Prefer ask unless you trust the session. Remote composers cannot elevate to full.

free.label: 自由实现
free.description: WARNING: historically advertised as auto-approve everything after ~8s for interactive prompts. Runtime maps free → ask so high-risk process/network/HTTP/shell tools require approval. Prefer ask for untrusted workspaces.

full.warning: full_access does not waive high-risk host process/network/HTTP/shell confirmation (enforced in Mutsuki resolve_approvals).

free.warning: free maps to Ask at the AgentKit boundary; not auto-approve for process/network/HTTP/shell.

remotePolicy.reason: Remote composers must not silently elevate beyond desktop-confirmed Ask; full is desktop-local only.
